xBRIEFInfo.description: Wire eval:health no-regression gate on rule-relocation PRs

plan.title: gate(agents-md): eval-health regression gate on rule-relocation PRs

narratives.Description: Wave 2 relocation moves enforceable rules, not just rationale. A byte-count gate will not catch silent behavior loss. This story wires eval:health (and preferably Tier-2 golden checks when cheap) as an acceptance gate on rule-relocation PRs under epic #2369.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Locate eval health entrypoints in packages/core/src (eval health score / contradictory-gate detector) and the CLI/task wiring for task eval:health. 2) Add packages/core/src gate helper that detects rule-relocation diffs (paths: AGENTS.md, content/templates/agents-entry.md, content/skills/**/SKILL.md, content/packs/**) and requires eval:health no-regression. 3) Wire into .github/workflows CI and/or task check path used by relocation PRs; seed baseline if needed without weakening relative agents-md-budget. 4) Unit tests in packages/core/src/**/**.test.ts covering classifier + fail path. 5) Verify: pnpm exec vitest run <new-tests> and task eval:health. 6) CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed/Added note.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want eval:health to gate rule-relocation PRs, so that moving rules out of always-on AGENTS.md cannot silently regress agent behavior.
narratives.Origin: Ingested and enriched for swarm from #2373 under epic #2369

items.title: Wire eval:health into relocation PR gate path

narrative.Acceptance: Given a PR classified as rule-relocation, when CI/local gate runs, then eval:health no-regression is required.
Given docs/CHANGELOG, when read, then fail-closed vs advisory seeding is explicit for Wave 2.
Given new unit tests, when vitest runs, then exit 0 and cover the relocation-gate path.
